metaDescription: Rhodesian Ridgeback vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Rhodesian Ridgeback boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Rhodesian Ridgeback social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Rhodesian Ridgeback exposure.
Weight range 70-85 lb (32-39 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat, weekly brush.) belong in the same Rhodesian Ridgeback household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Rhodesian Ridgeback is also monitored for elbow dysplasia, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Rhodesian Ridgeback appointments.
After the Rhodesian Ridgeback puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Rhodesian Ridgeback shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hip dysplasia worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Rhodesian Ridgeback make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Rhodesian Ridgeback antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Rhodesian Ridgeback dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this large dog.
Reset the Rhodesian Ridgeback reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Rhodesian Ridgeback core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Rhodesian Ridgeback misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Rhodesian Ridgeback health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Rhodesian Ridgeback adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
